teams.shape: three readers in parallel; verifier fetched alignment practices at once and verified claims as readers landed; cutter waited for all four
teams.outcome: Filed and verified under notepad/recon-2026-09-18/, distilled into DS001. Pilot corrected: the tip is the run-2 branch (pilot's own briefing error); spec-altitude added after the fork not deleted; interfaces rewrite never reached the tip; two remote-lag figures; no local branch named origin. Failures: two reports truncated (briefs said `pilot`, in-team address is `team-lead`); seven explorer hand-backs went to the lead only. Second pass changed both readers' reports materially.

teammate subagents hand back to the lead only; either the teammate reads directly or the lead relays

keep the whole team alive to the end; the second pass was where the value was
Explore subagents cost about 100k tokens each; seven was a large hidden spend

seats.name: source-reader

seats.returns: definitions, architecture, decisions, taste, quoted and dated; three method warnings

seats.reason: official-docs lookup
seats.returns: verification of every harness claim in each draft

seats.name: adversary
seats.reason: a record reaches the commander already contested once
seats.returns: about fifty findings across two passes; four withdrawn in writing

teams.shape: two readers in parallel to the writer and the lead; writer drafted, sent each draft to adversary and verifier, revised, delivered to the lead
teams.outcome: Five documents drafted, contested and revised in one session; the commander ruled them fully referenced source material, not records (DS002), and set the good-record docspec. Filed at notepad/research-2026-09-18/source/. Adversary withdrew four findings (false framing under a true id; true claim called overreach; correct code claim challenged on a header comment; verbatim quote called fabricated after stopping at the first match). Writer caught its own reversed model-tier claim. Verifier discarded its first pass after the fetch summariser invented a figure. Delivery intact via team-lead and scratchpad files.
lessons: this is the certified research shape: readers, a writer that re-verifies, an Opus adversary, a docs verifier on raw pages, the pilot ruling
check for a second occurrence before calling a quote fabricated; re-run every negative across spellings
a writer must contest the adversary with evidence; returning to the source saved a correct sentence
a WebFetch answer is model output over the page, not the page
transcript quotation needs three warnings in the brief: agent returns hide in user blocks; commissioned documents are not the commander's prose; pasted exchanges carry seams
consolidate the lead's fixes into one message; rulings crossing with revisions cost rounds
two seats should not share a name across teams; a dead seat revives when addressed
state they/them for anyone whose pronouns are not given

teams.purpose: Critique the pilot's cockpit work of the day and the approved plan from two angles: fit with the cockpit's purpose and corpus; bulk that can be trimmed without losing function

seats.name: fit-critic
seats.reason: fit with purpose is judgement
seats.returns: 13 then 7 findings; three high, all against the plan

seats.name: trim-critic
seats.reason: measuring bulk against function is judgement
seats.returns: 17 findings; the three biggest recurring costs named

teams.shape: two independent angles in parallel, no cross-talk by design; each re-read after the room changed under it
teams.outcome: Plan reshaped on the fit-critic's three high findings (crew cannot write where the plan sends them; docspec would restate rule 2; a third home for the commander's words). Trim-critic's three top cuts made: orders to JSON, session log capped, map trimmed. Second passes found seven pointer breaks from the dispatch rebuild, all fixed.
lessons: two independent angles found different things; keep them independent
run the critique before building: every high finding was against the plan, not the files
tell critics at dispatch that the ground may move and to re-read before reporting
a change made in one room must be made in every room that points into it

teams.shape: extractor first; discovery and validator as topics landed; writer drafted once topics were stable, sent each draft to adversary and validator, revised, delivered; the lead filed topics and put records to the commander as DS003
teams.outcome: Topic store filed (27 topics, 203 statements). Seven records drafted at notepad/research-2026-09-18/records-final/, dossier DS003, proposal P009. Two over-broad supersessions caught and narrowed. Two commander rulings obtained in session (O039, O040). Pilot's own errors caught by seats: two turn-opener line numbers in a ruling, one wrong advice-file attribution, one over-broad supersession ruling. The writer's script found one wrong citation in 83 that four passes had not.
lessons: the topic store is the right intermediate: it caught a superseded claim the writer had just added and made every quote checkable with one command
a summarising fetch can establish a presence but never an absence; check every negative against raw HTML
anchor findings on quoted text, not line numbers
a wrong citation is present and a missing one is absent; only a script that resolves each citation against its line catches it
a writer that applies a disputed ruling in its weakest true form and sends the question up is what gets the commander to answer it
brief every seat with the full read scope it will need; lifting boundaries mid-run cost rounds
two seats should not share a name across teams
extend a verifier and prove it fails on a bad input before trusting its pass
teams.status: finished; records await the commander's ruling on P009

teams.outcome: Four defects: record style defined only by exemplar; 'the library' undefined; two sourcing requirements unreconciled; a soft line cap. All fixed before the writer drafted.
lessons: run the doc-reviewer on any docspec before a team drafts against it

teams.outcome: fit-critic 14 findings, trim-critic 10, agreeing on one defect: a seat's identity written by hand into four files and already drifted three times. Applied: crew.json owns identity; dispatch seats are name, reason, returns; rosters are name lists; dossiers cut to purpose, how to dispatch, record, next time; five retired dossiers deleted with their status carried in the manifest; two turn-opener citations in the spec-builder dossier fixed; rules 7 and 10 name every store; status enums honoured; room indexes added. JSON 857 to 501 lines.
lessons: one owner per fact: the manifest owns who a seat is, the team entry owns what a team did, the dossier owns how to brief it, the README explains
a dossier briefs a seat; history goes in the team entry
a change in one room is a change in every room that points into it, again
run the mini-adversary roster on any structural rebuild before logging off

teams.shape: auditor and scout in parallel; option-maker drafts the option space at once and revises when both land; adversary spawned on the final paper
teams.outcome: Decision paper (99 lines) recommending vehicle routing with a drift trigger: procedures behind an imported trigger manifest carry the load, constant rules stay in CLAUDE.md, damage rules go to the guard, records on demand from the wide net with one header line under D021, a periodic currency review. Adversary: 23 findings and nine closing items, all answered, verdict stands. Auto memory and hook enforcement were missing options until the adversary named them. Distilled as DS004, raised as P010. Extended after approval (D022): the adversary checked the pilot's rule 2 and records README wording (seven findings, all taken); stub-writer compressed four drafts into stubs the commander read and the pilot landed (D024); option-maker designed the procedures room scaffold and five starting procedures, one adversary pass (four findings taken, three withdrawn once it saw O042). Distilled as DS005; P011 approved whole (D025); the manifest is imported into CLAUDE.md and measured live.
lessons: a decision team of auditor, docs scout, option-maker and adversary fits in one evening; the option-maker drafting from the start and revising on the reports saved a round
relay the commander's rulings to every seat at once; messages cross, and a seat working from a stale ruling wastes a pass
the option-maker attacked its own paper while idle and found a staffing defect; say in the brief that this is wanted
the adversary passing residuals ahead of its closing pass let them be closed in the same revision
measure a harness claim the paper depends on while the team works (the @ import test), rather than carrying it as a risk
put the commander's latest order on the subject in every seat's read scope; two adversary findings fell because O042 was left out of its brief
reusing a live team for the follow-on work (scaffold, wording check) cost no re-briefing; the seats already held the rulings
a stub writer needs the sibling drafts compared for contradiction; the pilot caught one the seat did not

convention: Seat identity (agent type, model) is in ../quarters/crew/crew.json; a seat here is name, reason, returns. Ids assigned once, never renumbered.
